scripts.build: npm run config:validate && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run config:validate && npm run test:e2e --workspace backend -- --runInBand
